name: Stablecorp QCAD
oneLiner: QCAD is Stablecorp's Canadian dollar stablecoin redeemable 1:1 against CAD fiat in regulated Canadian banks under the QCAD Digital Trust framework.
collateral: Canadian-dollar reserves held in regulated financial institutions under the QCAD Digital Trust framework for prospectus-qualified tokens; legacy QCAD issued before November 20, 2025 is excluded from that trust framework and has separate reserve accounts
pegMechanism: Qualified holders can mint and redeem QCAD at 1 CAD through Stablecorp or authorized partners; issuer APIs publish live supply and fiat reserve totals.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Stablecorp describes QCAD as a CAD-denominated token backed 1:1 by Canadian-dollar reserves, minted and redeemed by authorized partners. That issuer-managed cash claim and redemption path supports the fiat-cash archetype; it is not a borrower CDP, fund-share, or algorithmic stabilization mechanism.
